subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should this PR keep a first-class iOS Tailscale/MagicDNS onboarding path on top of the current main onboarding refresh, or should the work be split down to only the secure raw-IP/auth-copy pieces?
rationale: Current main already merged a different onboarding refresh, this PR conflicts with it, and the new Tailscale path changes first-run setup/security UX beyond a pure bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor and integrate the Tailscale path
options.body: Resolve the conflict by adapting this PR's secure Tailscale/MagicDNS chooser into current main's branded onboarding components, then rerun focused iOS proof.

options.title: Split security-only pieces
options.body: Close or pause the chooser direction and ask for a narrower PR that only preserves raw 100.x blocking and clearer auth/reachability copy.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Keep the merged onboarding refresh as the product baseline and track Tailscale-specific setup UX separately.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and integrate the Tailscale path
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict by adapting this PR's secure Tailscale/MagicDNS chooser into current main's branded onboarding components, then rerun focused iOS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Tailnet route and pairing work touched the same security/product boundary and provides the best available routing signal for this choice.
